_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary head term for the HR homepage; safe anchor term in title/H1/meta across the whole hr/ cluster.
phrases.good_example: Lijepi Fontovi i Stilizirana Slova za Kopiranje — Slova za Instagram, TikTok i Nadimke

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for section headers/intros presenting a ready alphabet or symbol set meant to be copied directly (A–Z tables, symbol grids).
phrases.good_example: Lijepa slova A–Z za kopiranje

phrases.usage_guidance: Standard CTA/step-language across the whole site; also the dominant brand phrase competitor HR font-generator sites use in their own titles, confirming it as the market-standard term (not a UTG coinage).
phrases.good_example: Klikneš „Kopiraj" kod onog koji ti odgovara i zalijepiš gdje god želiš.

phrases.english_concept: stylized name/text (decorated username or profile text)
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term across the Discord guide cluster for a display name using Unicode style substitutions, as distinct from Discord's paid Nitro font/color feature.
phrases.good_example: Stiliziraj ime na Discordu bez filtriranja

phrases.usage_guidance: Page-title term for the dedicated nickname-generator tool page; keep as the anchor term over 'generator imena' which is broader/vaguer.
phrases.good_example: Generator Nadimaka: Fensi Slova ꧁꧂ & Kul Nadimci za Igre

phrases.usage_guidance: Good informal hook phrase for gaming-nickname pages; borrowed English 'kul' (cool) is fully naturalized in Croatian youth/gaming register, not a register risk.
phrases.good_example: Kul nadimak svodi se na dvije stvari: drukčiji font i simbol koji uokviruje.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary head term for the dedicated symbols/decorations page; distinguish clearly from 'slova' (letters/font styles).
phrases.good_example: Posebni Znakovi — Simboli za Kopiranje i Znakovi za Nadimak

phrases.usage_guidance: Used when explaining the 'nickname with a space' or 'blank line in About Me' trick. Currently every hr/ mention links out to the English /library/invisible-character/ page — there is no hr-native equivalent page yet (see notes).
phrases.good_example: Kopiraj prazni znak sa stranice Invisible Character, pa ga zalijepi između dviju riječi.

phrases.register: casual, mildly frustrated in the wild
phrases.usage_guidance: Use for troubleshooting FAQ entries explaining why a rare style/character shows as a placeholder box instead of rendering.
phrases.good_example: Zašto se nekome prikazuju kvadratići umjesto slova?

phrases.english_concept: Croatian-specific characters (č ć đ š ž)
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary FAQ-category term for whether stylized fonts/diacritics work correctly; pairs naturally with the colloquial synonym 'naša slova' (HR-011) in body copy for warmth.
phrases.good_example: A hrvatski znakovi? Radi li s č, ć, đ, š, ž?

phrases.usage_guidance: Good warmer alternative to the more clinical 'hrvatski znakovi' in body copy or a hero line, e.g. when framing a diacritics-related feature or FAQ answer. Do not use in place of 'hrvatski znakovi' in a title/meta — it reads as too casual for search-facing copy.
phrases.good_example: Treba mi neki typewriter font, a da ima hrvatske dijakritičke znakove... koji fontovi imaju 'naša slova'?
phrases.avoid_when: title/meta/H1 (too colloquial for a search-facing headline)

phrases.english_concept: the diacritic hook/mark itself on Croatian letters
phrases.register: neutral, everyday (also used in formal linguistic contexts for č/š/ž specifically)
phrases.usage_guidance: Natural, precise word for explaining how the generator preserves diacritics through styling ('rastavlja slovo i kvačicu, stilizira slovo, vraća kvačicu'). Formally 'kvačica' names the mark on č/š/ž while ć/đ carry a different mark ('crtica'/acute-like stroke), but colloquial/internet usage — including UTG's own existing copy — treats 'kvačica' as covering all four loosely; that looseness is normal informal usage, not an error to fix.
phrases.good_example: Generator rastavlja č, ć, š, ž na osnovno slovo i kvačicu, stilizira slovo i vraća kvačicu na njega.
phrases.avoid_when: strict linguistic/editorial contexts requiring the č/š/ž vs ć/đ distinction

phrases.native_phrase: kako dobiti hrvatska slova (č, ć, đ, š, ž) na tipkovnici bez hrvatskog rasporeda
phrases.english_concept: typing Croatian diacritics on a non-Croatian keyboard/layout
phrases.usage_guidance: Strong candidate for a dedicated hr/ answers-style page or a small on-page 'copy hrvatska slova' helper (č ć đ š ž as one-click copy chips) — the underlying JTBD is well evidenced across a decade of forum threads, but every thread solves it with a different workaround (remap keys, get letters engraved, buy new keycaps, use stickers); none propose a simple 'just copy the character' web tool, so frame any such feature as a faster alternative to those workarounds, not as answering a literal 'is there a copy tool' request.
phrases.good_example: Kako dobiti č,ć,đ... na gaming tipkovnici?

phrases.usage_guidance: Useful as a secondary/informal synonym alongside 'nadimak' in gaming-specific copy (e.g. 'nadimak (nick)') to match how gamers actually talk about it in forums, without replacing 'nadimak'/'generator nadimaka' as the primary site term.
phrases.good_example: LoL Nickovi (da se ekipa lakše skupi)

phrases.usage_guidance: Use as a sub-heading for a short-nickname collection intended for clan tags, distinct from longer decorated 'aesthetic' nicknames.
phrases.good_example: Kratki / klanski nadimci — kratko, lako pamtljivo, savršeno za klanski tag.

phrases.english_concept: nickname with a space (using an invisible character trick)
phrases.usage_guidance: Use to introduce the invisible-character workaround for games that block literal spaces in name fields.
phrases.good_example: Kako napraviti nadimak s razmakom? ... Trik je koristiti nevidljivi znak.

phrases.english_concept: framing a nickname with ornament brackets (꧁꧂)
phrases.usage_guidance: Use when explaining how the Javanese/Tibetan ornament brackets are meant to be used — 'uokviriti' (to frame/enclose) is the natural verb, more precise than a generic 'dodati ukras'.
phrases.good_example: Samo kopiraj ꧁ i ꧂ iz palete na ovoj stranici i stavi ih na početak i kraj imena da uokviriš nadimak.

phrases.usage_guidance: Safe default translated form; used consistently on hr/index.html ('Estetski simboli', 'estetski i estetske fontove', 'estetskim biojevima'). Prefer this over the untranslated 'aesthetic' (HR-018) until/unless research specifically shows otherwise — it is the only one of the two forms independently standard Croatian vocabulary.
phrases.good_example: Estetski simboli: ✦ ✧ ⋆ ｡ ☆ ♡ ❀ ✿ — najčešće se koriste u estetskim biojevima na Instagramu i Pinterestu.

phrases.usage_guidance: Core term of the 'siguran nadimak bez filtriranja' guide sub-cluster; pairs with 'moderira'/'ograničavaju' when discussing server-level rules vs platform-wide rules.
phrases.good_example: Siguran nadimak na Discordu bez filtriranja

phrases.english_concept: Discord Nitro (paid feature), specifically contrasted with free Unicode styling
phrases.usage_guidance: 'Bez Nitra' (without Nitro) is a strong, differentiating hook — keep using it in Discord-page titles/meta since it directly answers a common point of confusion (do styled names require the paid tier).
phrases.good_example: Fontovi za Discord: Slova za Nadimak i Bio (Bez Nitra)

phrases.register: neutral, quoting a UI error string
phrases.usage_guidance: Use when explaining exactly which Discord field rejects styled Unicode text (@username) versus which fields accept it (display name, server nickname).
phrases.good_example: „Nevažeće korisničko ime." Naziv kanala koji je izgubio velika slova. Nadimak koji se spremio bez problema.

phrases.usage_guidance: Correct, safe formal register for explaining Zalgo text (stacked combining diacritics) or for any technical FAQ answer; prefer the warmer 'kvačica'/'naša slova' in casual marketing copy instead.
phrases.good_example: Zalgo je onakav 'ukleti', glitchani stil — nad i pod svakim slovom naleti hrpa dijakritičkih znakova.
phrases.avoid_when: casual hero/marketing copy where 'kvačica' or 'naša slova' reads warmer

phrases.usage_guidance: Already live as the primary head term on hr/generator-nadimaka/ (title, meta, hero) — treat as an established, working register choice for that page rather than something to replace. Don't assume it generalizes to other hr/ pages without separate evidence; it may be specific to the nickname-generator audience.
phrases.good_example: Fensi Slova za Nadimak
phrases.avoid_when: Formal/explanatory copy (guides, technical FAQ) where 'estetski' reads more natural.
